sellerDid.description: Immutable. Ownership transfer is not supported.

category.description: Freeform, seller-authored category (e.g. track, sample pack, ebook, brush pack). No fixed taxonomy. Freely mutable via putRecord.

tags.description: Freeform, seller-authored tags for search/filtering. No fixed taxonomy. Freely mutable via putRecord.

format.description: e.g. flac, mp3-320, wav, pdf, zip. Absent for non-file (dispensable) items. [immutable — new record required if changed]

fileChecksum.description: SHA-256 hex digest computed server-side from the received file bytes before S3 write. Verifiable by any standard tooling without ATProto context. Absent for non-file (dispensable) items — a license key or similar is not one fixed, publicly hashable payload. [immutable — new record required if changed]

fileCid.description: IPLD CID computed by the backend from the file content locally, not derived from any PDS operation. Content-addressed reference used for integrity verification. Absent for non-file (dispensable) items. [immutable — new record required if changed]

supersedes.description: AT-URI of the previous version of this item record. Present only when this record was created to replace an earlier version. Forms a resolvable version chain. The superseded record is never deleted.
